<!--
  VCHRGD / Frasers Plus 390 x 209 cart banner.
  Read more opens the official Frasers Plus website in a new tab.
-->
<style>
  .vchrgd-fp-cart,
  .vchrgd-fp-cart * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  .vchrgd-fp-cart {
    --fp-accent: #b115f4;
    isolation: isolate;
    display: flex;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 390px;
    min-height: 209px;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 13px 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    color: #fff;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 16% 2%, rgba(72,34,127,.6), transparent 48%),
      linear-gradient(140deg, #201143 0%, #080216 80%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Century Gothic", sans-serif;
  }

  .vchrgd-fp-cart__brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart__icon { width: 30px; height: 30px; object-fit: contain; }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart__wordmark { width: 175px; max-width: calc(100% - 38px); height: auto; }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart h2,
  .vchrgd-fp-cart p { margin: 0; color: inherit; }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart h2 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 750; line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart__apr { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart__legal { color: #eee9f7 !important; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.16; }

  .vchrgd-fp-cart__cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    min-height: 40px;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 3px;
    padding: 9px 16px;
    color: #fff !important;
    background: var(--fp-accent);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
    border-radius: 7px;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 750;
    line-height: 1;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    transition: transform 160ms ease, filter 160ms ease;
  }

  .vchrgd-fp-cart__cta:hover { filter: brightness(1.12); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .vchrgd-fp-cart__cta:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #43e9ed; outline-offset: 3px; }

  @media (max-width: 360px) {
    .vchrgd-fp-cart { min-height: 0; }
    .vchrgd-fp-cart h2 { font-size: 18px; }
  }
</style>

<section class="vchrgd-fp-cart" aria-labelledby="vchrgd-fp-cart-title">
  <div class="vchrgd-fp-cart__brand" aria-label="Frasers Plus">
    <img class="vchrgd-fp-cart__icon" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="">
    <img class="vchrgd-fp-cart__wordmark" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Frasers Plus">
  </div>
  <h2 id="vchrgd-fp-cart-title">Buy now. Pay later. Earn rewards</h2>
  <p class="vchrgd-fp-cart__apr">Representative 29.9% APR variable</p>
  <p class="vchrgd-fp-cart__legal">Credit subject to status. Terms apply. Missed payments may affect your credit score.</p>
  <a class="vchrgd-fp-cart__cta" href="https://frasersplus.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Read more</a>
</section>
